support.explanation: Identifies the exact recurrence-based lower bound mechanism constraining constant-memory optimization trajectories.
support.passage: recurrence. The proof constructs an explicit hard instance for the lower bound and a constant-memory first-order method, ITEM-wf (previously called ITEM-w), whose worst-case performance matches this lower bound.
